name: slack-compass
title: Slack Compass
description: Find Slack channels, people, and messages, see who is in which channel, and post or reply without leaving Raycast.
author: shinonomelon

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Slack Access Token
preferences.description: Your Slack User OAuth Token (xoxp-). See the README for setup.

preferences.name: previousHandles
preferences.title: Previous Handles
preferences.description: If you changed your Slack handle, list your previous handles separated by commas.

preferences.name: backgroundRefreshFrequency
preferences.title: Background Refresh Frequency
preferences.description: How often to refresh channels in the background. People refresh every 24 hours.

preferences.name: slackApiDistribution
preferences.title: Slack API Distribution
preferences.description: Select Verified only if your Slack app is internal to your workspace or approved for the Slack Marketplace.

commands.name: search-slack
commands.title: Search Slack
commands.description: Search channels, people, group DMs, and messages, then open, post, or reply.

commands.name: refresh-directory
commands.title: Refresh Slack Directory
commands.description: Refresh cached Slack directories according to the configured background frequency.
